label: Repeat Customer Rate
description: Percentage of bookings made by a returning customer.
formula_plain_english: percentage of bookings where repeat_flag indicates a repeat customer
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN {{repeat_flag}} IN {{repeat_values}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN {{repeat_flag}} IN {{repeat_values}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_bookings, COUNT(*) AS total_bookings FROM {{fact}}
